evidence.title: Prosecutors in Maradona death trial seek sentences up to 12 years

occurrences.checkable_against: Argentine court schedule and verdict record
occurrences.quote_span: The summation is expected to last around two weeks and the verdict is expected at a later date.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Argentine court records and prosecutors' sentencing requests in the Diego Maradona death trial
occurrences.quote_span: Argentine prosecutors argued on Thursday that the “chaotic” medical team treating football legend Diego Maradona at the time of his death should receive prison sentences of up to 12 years.
occurrences.speaker: Argentine prosecutors
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecutors' sentencing request and Argentine court record for Leopoldo Luque
occurrences.quote_span: The highest prison sentence sought by prosecutors was 12 years, for Maradona’s personal physician, Leopoldo Luque.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Formal charges and Argentine criminal law definition of dolo eventual in the Diego Maradona death case
occurrences.quote_span: The defendants are charged with “dolo eventual” – a legal term meaning that a person is aware that their actions could cause harm but persisted nonetheless.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Indictment and defense filings in the Diego Maradona death trial
occurrences.quote_span: His medical team, including his chief doctor, psychiatrist, psychologist and nurses, are accused of providing grossly inadequate care in the lead-up to his death. They deny the charges.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Defense arguments and filings in the Diego Maradona death trial
occurrences.quote_span: The health workers have argued that Maradona’s death could not have been foreseen and that they did their jobs.
occurrences.speaker: The health workers
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Defense statements and filings by each defendant in the Diego Maradona death trial
occurrences.quote_span: Each defendant has also downplayed their own individual responsibility for his care.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript of Cosme Iribarren's statement in the Argentine court
occurrences.quote_span: “Diego Armando Maradona’s death clearly did not come out of nowhere: the signs of this fatal outcome began to appear long beforehand,” assistant prosecutor Cosme Iribarren said on Thursday.
occurrences.speaker: Cosme Iribarren
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Court transcript and exhibit log for the Diego Maradona death trial
occurrences.quote_span: The prosecution again showed the court shocking images of the former footballer lying dead in bed, his stomach grotesquely swollen.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript of Patricio Ferrai's closing arguments in the Argentine court
occurrences.quote_span: He accused them of having “breached their duties, performed actions contrary to the art of healing” and having “omitted all the acts they were required to perform”.
occurrences.speaker: Patricio Ferrai
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Trial testimony and medical records concerning Maradona's condition before death
occurrences.quote_span: Several medical experts testified that Maradona’s carers failed to react to key warning signs – he was suffering from edema, tachycardia and had difficulty breathing – in the lead-up to his death.
occurrences.speaker: Several medical experts
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Trial record and evidence concerning Maradona's post-surgery care location
occurrences.quote_span: The case has revolved around whether the doctors’ decision to allow Maradona to convalesce in a private home, instead of in a hospital, was negligent.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Court attendance records and courtroom reporting from the summation
occurrences.quote_span: Maradona’s three daughters, who were present in court on Thursday for the start of the summation, covered their faces to avoid seeing the images.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecutors' sentencing requests and Argentine court record for the other defendants
occurrences.quote_span: Other sentences ranging from four to 10 years were sought for other medical staff, which include a psychiatrist, nurse and coordinators.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript of Patricio Ferrai's closing arguments in the Argentine court
occurrences.quote_span: In his closing arguments, prosecutor Patricio Ferrai said the defendants’ “chaotic organisation” left the ailing patient “in a helpless situation, abandoning him to his fate”.
occurrences.speaker: Patricio Ferrai
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecution evidence and trial exhibits concerning medical equipment and emergency response arrangements
occurrences.quote_span: The prosecution has also pointed to the near-total absence of medical equipment, such as a hospital bed, defibrillator or quickly available ambulance as evidence of what they presented as the defendants’ dereliction of duty.
occurrences.speaker: The prosecution
occurrences.subject: Seven medical professionals in the Diego Maradona death trial
